latest_post.summary: 前日の日経平均大幅高を受け、日本カーバイド工業とユニチカのストップ高、アイスタイルと太平洋セメントの決算嫌気による下落を報告。
latest_post.summary_en: Following the previous day's sharp rise in the Nikkei average, reports of stop-highs for Nippon Carbide Industries and Unitika, as well as declines for istyle and Taiheiyo Cement due to negative reactions to their financial results, were made.
